function.name: music_shop_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby music shops based on specific criteria like instrument lessons availability. Unlike gym_find_nearby, which locates nearby gyms, this locates nearby music shops.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Nashville, TN

services.description: Types of instrument lessons offered in the shop. Default empty array

instruments.description: Types of instruments sold in the shop. Default empty array

function.name: gym_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby gyms based on specific criteria like types of fitness classes availability. Unlike music_shop_find_nearby, which locates nearby music shops, this locates nearby gyms.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Nashville, TN

classes.description: Types of fitness classes offered in the gym. Default empty array

equipment.description: Types of gym equipment available. Default empty array
